rules.label: Self-pay discount for non-qualifiers
rules.quote: a.All uninsured patients receive a 40% Self-Pay discount on their account balance at the time of billing.

notes: Policy effective for dates of service on or subsequent to September 1, 2022.
Screening occurs within 45 days of date of service or discharge.
Patients may apply up to three months prior to receiving service; eligibility valid for one year after determination if approved.
Hospital will contact patient monthly for six months after discharge if no opt-out or verbal decline (not valid).
If patient requests cessation of contact, hospital must document and honor request.
If no response after 182 days of contact attempts, lack of cooperation considered informed decision to decline screening.
Patients not billed prior to 46 days after discharge.
Out-of-state Medicaid balances deemed infeasible to process are adjusted off as charity.
Nothing in policy affects right to pursue collection of personal injury, bodily injury, liability, etc.
Patients who do not qualify for financial assistance receive only the 40% self-pay discount.
Self-pay patients who opt out (sign form) subject to Co-Insurance and Payment Arrangement policy.
Good faith estimates provided to uninsured patients, but no payment request until opt-out or denial.
